structured.answer: I'd go with what the page puts on top: a Pesagot account with the Yalin Lapidot S&P 500 (4D) fund (5139282). It's labelled "הבחירה שלכם · הזול" and ends at 86,492 ₪ after 10 years, though I never changed the sliders from 10,000 to my 30,000.

They were set to 10,000 today, not my 30,000; I left them, so all the numbers aren't mine
Most of the 6,876 ₪ cost is pink 'מס'; I couldn't tell if that's on top of the fees or what it means
